-----Southern trigger walks player to Rowan-----
Freezes all NPC and Player in place.
Activates Action 1 where Rowan faces you and then displays a  [ ! ] symbol
Wait for Rowan to stop moving before running the next command
Stores player's name in variable 0x0, to use in any messages used by this script until it ends
Opens message text box with text 0x0 (Where Rowan says hellp and displays players name with macro)
Keep message 0x0 displayed until player hits A
Closes message text box
Gets player X and Y Matrix coodiantes. Stores X in variable 0x8004 and Y in varaible 0x8005. 
Does player's X matrix coordinate equal 110?
Jump to funtion 1 if previous command is true
Does player's X matrix coordinate equal 111?
Jump to funtion 2 if previous command is true
Does player's X matrix coordinate equal 112?
Jump to funtion 3 if previous command is true
Does player's X matrix coordinate equal 113?
Jump to funtion 4 if previous command is true
(this command is never hit, but needs to be there for formatting)

-----Northen trigger stops player from walking north before opening briefcase-----
Freezes all NPC and Player in place.
Opens message text box with text 0x2 (Where screams at you for trying to go north too early. Macro used makes text large)
Keep message 0x2 displayed until player hits A
Closes message text box
Activates Action 2 which steps you back down to stop you from passing the northern trigger
Waits for the player to stop moving before running the next command
Releases NPCs and Player so they can move again
Script ends and control is given back to player

-----A on Briefcase-----
Freezes all NPC and Player in place.
Fade screen to black. (Not sure what the parameters represent. They are copied from the original game freak script)
Wait for fade to end before running next command
Sets flag 2210, which will prevent the briefcase from being loaded when you return to the map later.
Removes the briefcase overworld sprite, which will be hidden behind the faded screen
Loads the 3D biefcase to picks starter from, (the briedcase screen runs it's own built in commands while you pick a starter)
Runs after you have chosen the starter. This also makes the "Pokemon" menu section appear, so you can access your party.
Returns the game from the briefcase back to the player and rowan, where the screen is still faded to black.
Fade the game from a black screen back to full view again.
Wait for fade to end before running next command.
Checks which starter was selected in the briefcase.
Gives the player the pokemon found by the previous command, and gives them a lvl 5 one in their first party slot.
Gets player X and Y Matrix coodiantes. Stores X in variable 0x8004 and Y in varaible 0x8005. 
Does player's Y matrix coordinate equal 873?
Jump to funtion 5 if previous command is true
Does player's Y matrix coordinate equal 872?
Jump to funtion 6 if previous command is true
Does player's Y matrix coordinate equal 871?
Jump to funtion 7 if previous command is true
(this command is never hit, but needs to be there for formatting)

-----Talk to Rowan-----
Freezes all NPC and Player in place.
Checks if flag 2210 is currently set or cleared
Jumps to function 8 if flag is currenly cleared (for if you hit A on Rowan before opening the briefcase)
Opens message text box with text 0xF (for if you hit A after picking a starter. Where they will say "Go Away.")
Keep message 0xF displayed until player hits A
Closes message text box
Releases NPCs and Player so they can move again
Script ends and control is given back to player

-------------------------------------------------

-----Walks player from southern trigger up to Rowan #1-----
Activates Action 3 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the souther trigger tile in the 110 Matrix X coodinate.
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 9

-----Walks player from southern trigger up to Rowan #2-----
Activates Action 4 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the souther trigger tile in the 111 Matrix X coodinate.
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 9

-----Walks player from southern trigger up to Rowan #3-----
Activates Action 5 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the souther trigger tile in the 112 Matrix X coodinate.
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 9

-----Walks player from southern trigger up to Rowan #4-----
Activates Action 6 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the souther trigger tile in the 113 Matrix X coodinate.
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 9

-----Walks player from briefcase up to Rowan #1-----
Activates Action 7 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the tile that is south of the briefcase. (Matrix y:  873)
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 10

-----Walks player from briefcase up to Rowan #2-----
Activates Action 8 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the tile that is east of the briefcase. (Matrix y:  872)
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 10

-----Walks player from briefcase up to Rowan #3-----
Activates Action 9 that walks the player infront of Rowan from the tile that is north of the briefcase. (Matrix y:  871)
Waits for the movement to stop before running the next command
Jumps to Function 10

-----Talking to Rowan before opening briefcase-----
Opens message text box with text 0xE (Where Rowan encourages to go pick a starter)
Keep message 0xE displayed until player hits A
Closes message text box
Releases NPCs and Player so they can move again
Script ends and control is given back to player

-----Rowan says hello and summons briefcase -----
Stores rival's name in variable 0x1, to use in any messages used by this script until it ends
Opens message text box with text 0x1 (Where Rowan says he was expecting you, and offers you a starter. Displays rival name with macro)
Keep message 0x1 displayed until player hits A
Closes message text box
Teleports the briefcase to the tile to the right of Rowan. (Hex Values: Overworld ID: 2, Matrix X: 112, Matrix Z: 0, Matrix Y: 872, Direction facing: 0- Doesn't matter for briefcase)
Sets variable 16620 to 1, which deactivates the southern trigger and activates the northern trigger
Releases NPCs and Player so they can move again
Script ends and control is given back to player

-----Rowan asks if you want to nickname your starter-----
Opens message text box with text 0x3 (where you are asked if you want to give your new pokemon a name) 
Open Yes/No selection box and stores your selection in variable 0x800C
Checks the current value in 0x800C and compares it to 0x0 (which is yes)
Jumps to Function 11 if the player selected yes
Jumps to Function 12 if the player selected no
(this command is never hit, but needs to be there for formatting)

-----Opens the name entry screen-----
Sets 0x800C to 0 (which it already was back when the player said "yes" so I am not sure why... but this is how game freak did this part so I am following their example.) 
Closes message text box
Fade screen to black. (Not sure what the parameters represent. They are copied from the original game freak script)
Wait for fade to end before running next command
Loads the name entry screen and points it at the first pokemon in your party
(This copies the value of variable 0x800C to variable 0x8002, though this is also from the default game freak script i am not sure why as 0x8002 isn't used again)
Fade the game from a black screen back to full view again.
Wait for fade to end before running next command
Opens message text box with text 0x4 (Where Rowan asks if you are certain about your name)
Open Yes/No selection box and stores your selection in variable 0x800C
Checks the current value in 0x800C and compares it to 0x1 (which is no)
Jumps to Function 11 if the player selected no (where this same script starts over and reopens the name entry screen)
Jumps to Function 13 if the player selected yes
(this command is never hit, but needs to be there for formatting)

-----Rowan provides you with tools for your trip-----
Changes text box that is already open to message text 0x5 (Where Rowan says he is giving you the pokedex)
Keeps message 0x5 displayed until player hits A
Closes text box
Give player the pokedex
Play sound 0x486 (standard get item sound effect)
Stores player's name in variable 0x0, to use in any messages used by this script until it ends
Opens message text box with text 0x6 (Where it is announced that the player got the Pokedex. Player name is dislpayed with the macro)
Wait for sound 0x486 to finish before running the next command (all commands between this command and the PlaySound command above will run while the sound plays)
Keep message 0x6 displayed until player hits A
Changes current text box to display text 0x7 (Where Rowan says he is giving you the national dex)
Keep message 0x7 displayed until player hits A
Upgrades player to the national dex
Play sound 0x486 (standard get item sound)
Changes current text box to display text 0x8 (Where it is annoucned that the player got the Pokedex. Player name is dislpayed with the macro)
Wait for sound 0x486 to finish before running the next command (all commands between this command and the PlaySound command above will run while the sound plays)
Keep message 0x8 displayed until player hits A
Changes current text box to display text 0x9 (Where Rowan says he is giving you the Pokétch)
Keep message 0x9 displayed until player hits A
Gives the player the Pokétch
Play sound 0x486 (standard get item sound)
Changes current text box to display text 0xA (where it is annoucned that the player got the Pokétch. Player name is dislpayed with the macro)
Keep message 0xA displayed until player hits A
Changes current text box to display text 0xB (Where Rowan says he is giving you the running shoes)
Keep message 0xB displayed until player hits A
Gives the player the running shoes
Play sound 0x486 (standard get item sound)
Changes current text box to display text 0xC (where it is annoucned that the player got the running shoes. Player name is dislpayed with the macro)
Wait for sound 0x486 to finish before running the next command (all commands between this command and the PlaySound command above will run while the sound plays)
Keep message 0xC displayed until player hits A
Changes current text box to display text 0xD (Where Rowan says their fairwell)
Keep message 0xD displayed until player hits A
Closes message text box
Sets variable 16620 to 2, which now disables the northern trigger and keep the southern trigger disabled
Releases NPCs and Player so they can move again
Script ends and control is given back to player

-----Commit new name to pokemon-----
Unammed command that commits the provided nickname to your new starter.
Jumps to Function 12
